hangulquest.ui.research.consent:
Hangul Quest research export

You made this zip yourself, on your computer, with the button "Export research data" in the journal settings. Nothing was sent anywhere. Whether you share it is entirely up to you; if you do not want to, just delete it.

What is in it
- reviews.ndjson: one line per answer or encounter with a word: the time, a hashed word id, how it was answered (mode and grade), how long it took, how many days passed since the previous review, a short place label (quiz, quest, card or probe), the experiment arm of the word, and whether it is a core word.
- The word ids are hashed with a random key that was made for this export and then thrown away. The same word has a different hash in every export, so the ids cannot be turned back into words and two exports cannot be linked.

What is not in it
No player, account, world, server or chat names, no coordinates, no IP address, no settings, no quest or trail names. The times are real: they show when you played.

Why share it
The Hangul Quest project compares review settings word by word to learn what helps people remember Korean. Sharing is voluntary and manual: attach the file yourself, where the project page says to.
hangulquest.ui.research.placement.title: Vocabulary check
hangulquest.ui.research.placement.intro: About 3 minutes. Korean words appear one at a time. Press Yes if you know what the word means, No if you do not. Some words are made up: saying Yes to those lowers your score. It is optional, and you can stop at any time.
hangulquest.ui.research.placement.skip: Esc stops the check; nothing is saved.
hangulquest.ui.research.placement.score: Score %s of 100. You knew %s of %s real words and claimed %s of %s made-up words.
hangulquest.ui.research.placement.seeded: %s words you know will come back in a few days for a quick check.
hangulquest.ui.research.placement.unreli: You said Yes to many made-up words, so no words were added.
